title: Live: Thread-level message/memory primitives on MemoryStore
summary: New tests/integration/test_thread_primitives.py — add_messages/get_messages/delete_message, add_memory/add_user/add_agent, generic delete_memory(id), and the raw-text search() facade, all against real Db2 (THRD-1, THRD-2, THRD-3, THRD-8).
description:
These six store.py methods (add_messages, get_messages, delete_message, add_memory/add_user/add_agent, delete_memory, search) are grouped into one story because each is a small, related convenience wrapper over already-live-tested repositories, and grouping avoids fragmenting simple coverage across too many files. All are currently unit-tested only with a fake cursor. Add tests/integration/test_thread_primitives.py against the live `store`/`thread_scope` fixtures:

add_messages()/get_messages()/delete_message(): batch-insert a list of message dicts, assert get_messages(start, end) slicing returns the correct real subset in order, delete_message(id) removes exactly that row and no others in the scope.

add_memory()/add_user()/add_agent(): assert each dispatches to the correct real repository/role tagging and the row is retrievable afterward with the expected metadata.

delete_memory(id): call it against an id from each of the five memory-type tables in turn and assert the table-agnostic dispatch actually deletes from the right real table each time (this is the one genuinely table-agnostic method — verify it isn't accidentally hardcoded to one table).

search() (THRD-3's raw-text facade): call store.search(query, scope) with a real embedding_provider configured and assert it returns SearchResult objects assembled across the documented working->episodic->facts->profiles->procedures order, capped at max_results, matching real rows in Db2; also cover the metadata_filter passthrough with a live filter. Define local fixtures inside this file only.

comments.text: Done. Created tests/integration/test_thread_primitives.py — 23 tests: THRD-1 (add/get/delete messages with slice semantics, idempotent delete, wrong-id returns 0), THRD-2 (add_memory/add_user upsert/add_agent), THRD-3 (search facade with HashEmbedder, record_types filter, metadata_filter passthrough), THRD-8 (delete_memory dispatches to correct real table for facts/profiles/procedures).
